title: Dont miss this tour!
text: Wow, I'll be back to Barcelona because of this tour.  You can visit on your own but be prepared to miss a LOT.  Andrew was the perfect host and we had so much fun, learned a ton, and experienced what many will miss.  Thank you for making this a wonderful first time experience the best ever.
author: Colette_C

title: Great walk through Gothic...
text: Great walk through Gothic Quarter, delicious tapas and cava, capped off with the Flamenco dance. Victoria was a fantastic guide!
author: CarloEmmanuel_D

title: Exceptional Guided Experience of Barcelona
text: Paolo was na wonderful guide very informative, fun and engaging.  The tour was great with enough time to cover many areas of the city and its rich history

title: Sharon was very well...
text: Sharon was very well informed and delightful to talk to. She was extremely helpful and went above and beyond when one member of our party fell ill and had to drop out during the tour.
author: Sherry_M

title: First Barcelona stay
text:
My wife and I had a wonderful time with Victoria.
Her extensive historical knowledge and enthusiasm  made our personal tour one of the best we have done in over 40 years of traveling.
Never was rushed, had delicious Tapas, drinks, and a great show to top off the night.
author: H2300LEwilliamw

title: Great private tour.  Did...
text: Great private tour.  Did not realize it was private. Our guide was excellent. Even helped us with activities and dinner recommendations for the following day.  He vas very friendly and informative. Would actually ask for Horacio again for any tour the next time in Barcelona
author: Richard_R

title: Above and beyond
text: This tour was excellent.  I did not realize it was a private tour.  Horacio was warm funny and really knew his stuff.  Took the time to make sure we understood everything presented and was a wealth of information. Above and beyond the historical sites.  This included suggestions for what to do the next day and where to eat
author: 851richardrr

title: Educational, fun and tasty! We enjoyed this tour vey much!
text:
Friendly yet professional guide who is knowledgeable but keeps it interesting by focusing on showing you landmarks and shops based on your personal interests!
Andy showed us some historic sites, pointed us to amazing drinks and tapas and made sure he got us everywhere timely without making us feel rushed. The flamenco dancing was impressive and a perfect way to end the night.
author: Hilda M
